index: IBVCI - Indian Biodiversity Vulnerability and Cascade Index
label: EXPERIMENTAL RESEARCH METRIC

components.climate_niche_narrowness: narrow temperature niche at precisely located records (climate-sensitivity proxy, not exposure)
components.range_restriction: few ~50 km cells with records (range-size proxy)
components.recording_decline: fewer records 2016+ than 2006-2015 (recording-trend proxy, not abundance)
components.protection_deficit: share of precisely located records outside wildlife protected areas
components.habitat_loss: tree-cover loss 2015-2024 relative to year-2000 forest in the cells the species occupies (Hansen GFC)
components.human_pressure: built-up share of land in the cells the species occupies (GHSL 2020)

weights_note: Unweighted mean: a neutral reference, not derived from literature or data. Pass weights=name:value,... to explore alternatives.
scaling: each component is a 0-1 percentile rank among items with data
minimum_components: a composite needs at least 67% of the components; others are listed with insufficient_data and no rank
sensitivity: 1000 random weightings (Dirichlet(1)); ranks are 1 = highest composite
caveats: Experimental metric developed within this project; not an established or official index.
Components overlap (e.g. the vulnerability model already uses range and protection features), so the composite double-counts some signals.
Occurrence-based components reflect recording effort as well as ecology.
Tree-cover loss includes plantation harvest and natural disturbance; it is pressure on places, not a measured effect on species.
